## 🚀 1. Product Hunt Launch Copy

**Product Name:** LaunchMe OS for Windows 11  
**Tagline:** Liquid Glass Launcher, Dynamic Notch HUD, Dock & Golden-Ratio Tiling  
**Topics:** Windows, Productivity, Developer Tools, Open Source, Design Tools  

### Description (Short):
LaunchMe OS brings high-craft workspace ergonomics to Windows 11. Built from the ground up in C# 13 and .NET 9 with WinUI 3 and Win2D, it unifies a crystal-clear full-screen app launcher, an interactive dynamic notch HUD with local AI agent approvals, a multi-display dock with procedural soundscapes, and Golden-Ratio BSP dynamic window tiling. Zero telemetry. 0% idle GPU.

### First Comment / Maker Story:
> Hey Product Hunt! 👋
> 
> For years, Windows power users, designers, and developers have had to stitch together 4 or 5 different utilities (PowerToys, various dock apps, third-party tiling managers, clipboard managers) just to get a clean, fluid desktop workflow. Most of them either look out of place on Windows 11 or consume high background GPU resources.
> 
> We built **LaunchMe OS** as a unified, native desktop shell:
> 
> 🪟 **Crystal-Clear Full-Screen Launcher:** Floating icon grid with up-to-1024px G2 super-ellipse squircle icons and live Explorer file previews (`Alt+Space`).  
> 🏝️ **Snoot Dynamic Notch HUD:** Symmetrical bento cards featuring live AI Desktop App status (Antigravity, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), live running task detection, and a local AI agent approval cockpit (Pookie) that intercepts terminal commands before they execute.  
> 🚢 **Multi-Display Dock:** Floating continuous G2 obsidian glass with hardware telemetry gauges and real-time 9-band procedural AudioDSP ambient soundscapes (rain, waves, forest) with zero external audio files.  
> 📐 **Squish Dynamic Window Tiling:** Golden-Ratio Binary Space Partitioning window tiling that commits layout changes in a single V-Sync frame (`DeferWindowPos`) with zero window flickering.  
> 🔒 **Strictly Local-First & 0% Idle GPU:** Private local SQLite database, zero tracking, and our strict Pause-on-Hide law ensuring 0% background GPU usage when drawers are closed.
> 
> It's available today as a self-contained portable ZIP, 1-click installer, and on Winget. Would love your feedback and thoughts!

## 💬 2. Reddit Post (r/Windows11, r/software, r/pcmasterrace)

**Title:** I built an ultra-fluid desktop workspace shell for Windows 11 in C# / WinUI 3 (Full-Screen Launcher, Dynamic Notch, Dock & BSP Tiling)

**Body:**
Hey everyone!

I wanted to share a project I've been working on called **LaunchMe OS** — an open-source, local-first workspace manager for Windows 11 written in C# 13, .NET 9, WinUI 3, and Win2D.

### Why I built it:
I love keyboard-driven ergonomics, dynamic window tiling, and modern fluid glass UI, but having multiple separate apps running in the background always felt clunky or drained battery. I wanted a single, unified, lightweight native shell that feels like it was designed by a luxury editorial team for Windows 11.

### What it does:
1. **Crystal Clear Launcher (`Alt+Space`):** A full-screen floating icon canvas where your wallpaper remains visible. Extracts up to 1024px icons with smooth G2 super-ellipse squircle clipping and live QuickLook-style file search previews.
2. **Snoot Dynamic Notch HUD:** Sits at the top of your screen with an interactive overview bento showing live AI app shortcuts (Antigravity, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) with real-time running task counters and instant window focus. Also includes an approval cockpit for AI CLI agents, a drag-and-drop file shelf, and a 7-category clipboard card manager.
3. **Multi-Display Dock:** Translucent obsidian glass capsule with a Touch Bar quick action strip (`Focus`, `Snap`, `Term`, `Lock`), real-time CPU/RAM/Network meters, and a 9-band procedural sound generator (rain, forest, ocean) synthesized entirely through code without any audio files.
4. **Squish Golden-Ratio BSP Tiling:** Window tiling engine dividing displays along the golden ratio using atomic `DeferWindowPos` so windows resize seamlessly without tearing.
5. **Full-Screen Reactive Music Player:** Live album-art ambient backlighting synchronized across Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube Music via Windows GSMTC.

### Engineering & Privacy:
- **0% Idle GPU Law:** All Win2D renderers and composition springs detach completely when drawers close.
- **100% Local-First:** No cloud telemetry, no analytics, everything lives in a local SQLite database.
- **Self-Contained:** Portable ZIP requires no .NET SDK or runtimes installed.

**GitHub & Download:** [Link to your GitHub Release]  
**Winget:** `winget install LaunchMe.OS`

Feedback and suggestions are very welcome!
